scope: old 10-image development multi-SNR CMI pilot; not the 100-image frozen holdout
noise_coupling: same seed for each image/trial across SNRs; scaled-noise common-random-number design
interleaver: author-demo fixed token index mod64; not paper randomized packet positions
physical_chain: existing Sionna 0.19.2 AWGN CRC11 convolutional [101,111] soft Viterbi 16-QAM
mask: same sender-truth oracle packet mask for both generation paths
metric_conventions: same raw PSNR, clamped normalized LPIPS and clipped PIL CLIP as primary; separate development cohort
aggregation: only complete 50-reception SNR groups are summarized; five trials within each image then ten images; incomplete SNR groups are coverage only
ideal_reference: correct source token decode, not physical retries; payload-only ideal ARQ from true packet PER
